timeline.text: My daughter's bonus math task kept handing her the exact same problem — 69 times 71 — three days running.
It felt like a bug, and it never fixed what she actually got wrong.
I gave the quiz a memory in Supabase — the last 200 questions each kid has seen — so a maker rerolls before repeating one.
A third of every bonus set now even targets her actual weak topics.
36,600 generated answers checked after the fix: zero duplicates, zero repeats.
